enemyEvidence.measurementMethod: PNG RGBA metadata and SHA-256; silhouette bounding box at alpha >=16 with exclusive lower/right edges. Original source bytes copied unchanged, no crop/rescale/recolor/mirror performed on the masters.
limits: Official public storyboard samples are 320x180 cells sampled every 10 seconds; they are reference evidence, not full-resolution model sheets or pixel-identical pose references.
The neutral standing/resting arrangement and orientation are adaptations for the reserve catalogue.
No in-game placement, relative canonical scale, animation, attack, collision or gameplay test is claimed; these six assets remain reserve-only.
Alpha values 1-15 contain minor peripheral noise; no destructive alpha thresholding was applied. Measurements use alpha >=16, and visual review used the unmodified RGBA image.
